map.支持 14 位 IMEI 本体、15 位 IMEI 的 Luhn 校验及 16: Check a 15-digit IMEI with Luhn, calculate the check digit for a 14-digit body, or parse a 16-digit IMEISV without a check digit. This does not verify device authenticity.
map.15 位 IMEI：由右至左偶位 × 2（> 9 减 9）后求和，总和 mod: 15-digit IMEI: double alternate digits from the right (subtract 9 if over 9); the sum modulo 10 is zero. A 16-digit IMEISV consists of an 8-digit TAC, 6-digit SNR and 2-digit SVN and has no check digit.
map.15 位 IMEI 按 Luhn 校验；14 位本体仅计算建议校验位，16 位: A 15-digit IMEI is checked with Luhn; a 14-digit body only yields a suggested check digit. A 16-digit IMEISV is parsed structurally and has no check digit. Results do not verify authenticity.
map.IMEISV 不含校验位，仅检查 16 位数字结构，无法验证真实性。: IMEISV has no check digit; only the 16-digit structure is checked, not authenticity.
map.含非法字符，仅允许数字、空格和连字符: Invalid characters: only digits, spaces and hyphens are allowed

map.解析 TAC 型号分配码与序列号分段: Parse the TAC model-allocation code and serial-number segments

map.IMEI 15 位与 14 位的关系？: What is the relationship between 15- and 14-digit IMEI?
map.14 位为设备主体（TAC 8 位+序列号 6 位），15 位 IMEI 的第: The 14-digit body consists of an 8-digit TAC and 6-digit serial number. A 15-digit IMEI adds a Luhn check digit; a 16-digit IMEISV instead adds a 2-digit software version and has no check digit.
map.校验通过代表手机正品吗？: Does passing validation mean the phone is genuine?
map.不代表。IMEI 校验只验证格式，是否报失、是否为正品须在运营商或厂商数据库查询: No. The IMEI check only verifies format; whether it is reported lost or genuine must be queried in the operator's or manufacturer's database.
map.IMEI 和 MEID 的区别？: What is the difference between IMEI and MEID?
map.IMEI 用于 GSM/UMTS/LTE 设备，MEID 用于 CDMA 设备，: IMEI is for GSM/UMTS/LTE devices, MEID for CDMA devices; the two differ in format and length.
